Subject: Quick question on accelerator credits and usage limits

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team and I liked what we saw. We're exploring Redwood for our next-stage sandbox for early adopters and have two asks that will determine which vendor we pilot with:

1) Program credits: Our accelerator gives startups $15k in platform credits. We need to know whether Redwood will allow splitting that pool between two projects owned by the same company (sandbox + internal POC). Some vendors treat credits as a single account asset and won't split.

2) Usage-safeguard: Our startups run unpredictable token spikes. We need a hard-guard option (daily cap + alerting) tied to the promo credits so a runaway job doesn't burn the entire allotment in a single day. Is this something you support out of the box or as an add-on?

If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-min call — but a short email recap works too.

Cheers,

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed. Short answers up front: yes to split, and yes to a guard (configurable). Details below.

1) Credit split
- We can issue the accelerator credit as a single sponsored balance on NeuroCraft's account and allocate sub-quotas to multiple projects under that account.
- The admin console supports per-project caps and a simple UI to reassign remaining balance between projects.
- For legal/contract purposes we typically call this a "sponsored pool" and tie expiration and usage rules to the sponsor agreement.

2) Usage-safeguard
- We offer two mechanisms: a hard daily token cap (blocks requests when exceeded) and a soft cap that triggers throttling + high-priority alerts.
- Both can be scoped to the sponsored pool so they won't affect billed usage outside the program.

Next steps I propose: I attached a one-page proposal (Redwood_Starter_Proposal_v3.pdf) that shows a recommended split, sample daily caps by workload, and a simple SLA for pilot months. If that looks reasonable, I can loop in Ben (sales) and Laura (accelerator ops) to confirm pricing and approvals.

I'll attach the proposal now.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Ben / Laura — forwarding NeuroCraft's ask (below). Key points: 15k in sponsor credits, want to split across two projects, and want a hard daily cap tied to the promo pool.

Proposal (attached) suggests: 70/30 split, daily hard cap at 30% of monthly allotment for sandbox project (to avoid burst burns), and soft cap/alerts for the POC project.

Can we sign off on the following exceptions for this partner pilot?
- Promo discount: allow a one-time promotional uplift (extra 10% credits) for the pilot cohort.
- Billing: NeuroCraft wants the sponsored pool on their account; startups should not receive invoices.

I think this is a good strategic partner — they'd run several founders through us next quarter if pilot goes well.

Thanks — please reply with approvals or redlines.

Thanks for the context, Hannah. I'm good to proceed with a partner-friendly exception with the following constraints:

- Promotional uplift: approve one-time +15% on top of the $15k pool for pilot cohort only (so total sponsored credits = $17,250). This is a marketing-backed concession and we track it separately in reporting.
- Split: 70/30 as proposed is fine. We'll enforce via the sponsored-pool UI and tag usage to NeuroCraft's HubSpot deal DEAL-6789-NC.
- Hard cap: we can configure a daily hard-block at 30% of the monthly prorated allotment. Ops will configure an automatic rollback if the cap is hit three days in a row.
- Contract: require a short amendment that lists the sponsored pool terms and the expiration date for the promo credits (90 days from activation).

Laura — can you confirm operational readiness to set the caps and alerts? If yes, I'll draft the short amendment and loop in Legal.
